subject: REPORT clause
notes: (kb/Work PB1050, wave 1005 A). 'The presence of more than one report-name-1 indicates that more than one report may be written to the file' (cite.py --check 13.18.46.4 OK 1)). A multi-report FD is no longer refused: ResolveReports binds each report to its FD (model.File) and EmitReportConstruction gives each its own CobolReport engine over the one connector (the held-back-line claim of kb/Work PB1247 orders the records). pb1050_reports_share_file interleaves GENERATEs of two reports and asserts the records in GENERATE order, told apart by their CODE characters. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Editions/Diagnostics/DiagnosticCatalog.cs#ReportMultipleOnFile (the descriptor was deleted: a file description entry may name several reports and each has its own engine)
